message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Tests
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        python-version: ['3.9', '3.10', '3.11', '3.12', '3.13']
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v2
    - name: Set up Python ${{matrix.python-version}}
      uses: actions/setup-python@v2
      with:
        python-version: ${{matrix.python-version}}
    - name: Cache pip dependencies
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/.cache/pip
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('pyproject.toml') }}-${{ matrix.python-version }}
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ matrix.python-version }}-
          ${{ runner.os }}-pip-
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        python -m pip install .[test]
    - name: Test with pytest
      run: |
        pytest tests

  examples:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v2
    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v2
      with:
        python-version: '3.12'
    - name: Cache pip dependencies
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/.cache/pip
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('pyproject.toml') }}-3.12
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-pip-3.12-
          ${{ runner.os }}-pip-
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        python -m pip install .
    - name: Run examples
      env:
        MPLBACKEND: Agg
      run: |
        for f in examples/ex_*.py; do
          echo "Running $f"
          python "$f"
        done",
  "rationale": "Both jobs reinstall Python dependencies from PyPI on every run with no dependency cache. The retrieved experiment evidence (P-LIT-DISTRIBUTED-CACHE / P-LIT-GHA-CACHE) directly shows adding an actions/cache@v4 step for ~/.cache/pip, keyed on the dependency manifest hash, before pip install, measured a ~9-10% elapsed-time reduction on a comparable Python test workflow using pip install .[dev] and pytest. I applied the same minimal change to both the build matrix job and the examples job, keying the cache on pyproject.toml plus Python version so cache entries stay distinct per environment. All existing jobs, steps, matrix versions, test commands, and example execution are preserved; no permissions, secrets, deployment, or new external network access is added.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2", "experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-3d6f1c5a422aa116-r2"]
}
